what_it_does: Presents eIM, a GPU-accelerated algorithm for influence maximization—finding the most impactful set of people to target in a social network to maximize information spread. The problem is computationally hard (NP-hard). The state-of-the-art GPU implementation uses reverse reachable sets (RRR sets)—precomputed data structures representing which users can reach each user in the network—but requires enormous memory to store these sets. eIM optimizes memory usage while preserving correctness, achieving similar accuracy to existing baselines but with dramatically lower memory requirements.
